vulnerability.name: USN-8778-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that GStreamer Good Plugins did not limit the size of reassembly buffers when processing fragmented RTP packets. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to cause GStreamer Good Plugins to use excessive resources, leading to a denial of service.

statements.status_notes: GStreamer Good Plugins could be made to consume resources if it received specially crafted network traffic.
